biocs.name: Registry Credentials Extraction Process
biocs.description: Detection of reg.exe process execution with arguments that query sensitive registry paths
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'query'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'SAM'
